doc.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Closing remarks and thanks
summary: Final thanks, greetings to Conte and the closing of the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Wow. Well this has been really quite fascinating.
Well it has been for me. I’m recalling things I forgot. I’m sorry.
Well when we do Part Two down the line, we’ll make up for it— © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
Oh anytime Monk, I hope it helps the archives.
I hope so. I told Conte I was going to be seeing you.
Yeah. Well thanks for your time, and I wish you continued success with all your future adventures.
Anytime I can be of any help—
Can you imagine if some day if someone showed up at your house with every record you ever played on?
You’d have to have a whole—
Gosh I’m still active and in good health, so I’m thankful for everything, really.
All right, thanks for your time.
Thanks Monk, thank you so much, and the school, thank you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
